subject: MSA/Order Form intake: signer matrix & template alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Sasha Patel <sasha@nimbledata.com>
Cc: legal@nimbledata.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA/Order Form intake: signer matrix & template alignment

Hi all,

Looping you in on the NimbleData intake so we can get the MSA and Order Form moving. Attached: the customer's baseline MSA (they labeled it "Nimble_MSA_v1") and their Exhibit A pricing spreadsheet.

Quick asks to get us started:
- Kimberly/Karthik: can you confirm whether we should route this through the standard Redwood MSA template or start from the counterparty doc and redline in-track? We have a few recent template updates (SLA wording + data residency exhibit) that may matter.
- Sasha/Amir: please confirm who will sign on behalf of NimbleData (title and email for signatures) and whether they need any specific billing contact or PO number on the Order Form.
- Timeline: customer is hoping to be live in mid-August; we need legal redlines + procurement sign-off by end of July to hit that.

I created a lightweight signer matrix below — please edit in your reply:
- Customer signer: Sasha Patel, Head of Legal (sasha@nimbledata.com)
- Billing contact: Amir Khan, Finance (amir.khan@nimbledata.com) — TBD if PO required
- Redwood signer: will confirm (legal sign-off + commercial sig)

Attachments: Nimble_MSA_v1_redline.docx (customer draft), ExhibitA_Pricing.xlsx

Next step proposal: Kimberley/Karthik do an initial redline pass against our template; I will produce a short summary memo (2–3 bullets) of any commercial/SLAs we expect to change. If there are any high-risk clauses (data retention, export, indemnity caps), flag them for a quick sync.

Thanks — I can host a 20-minute kickoff at 10:00 PT today if that helps.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0147

[Attachment: Nimble_MSA_v1_redline.docx (docx)]
[Attachment: ExhibitA_Pricing.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Sasha Patel <sasha@nimbledata.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form intake: signer matrix & template alignment

Marissa — thanks for the intake. I agree we should start from Redwood's template and track redlines; the counterparty doc has a few nonstandard exhibits that we'll want to map (notably an alternate SLA schedule and a data destruction clause).

Action items from my side:
- I'll do the first redline pass against our current MSA template (will call out changes to indemnity and data language). Target EOD Tue (7/15).
- Kimberly, can you check whether the customer needs SOC 2 evidence in folder or if a self-attestation will suffice for procurement?

Marissa — I'd take the 10:00 PT kickoff if it happens, otherwise I'll drop substantive comments into the attached redline doc.

Karthik
Director, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form intake: signer matrix & template alignment

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers from our side:
- Signer: I will sign the MSA as Head of Legal (Sasha Patel). Email for signing: sasha@nimbledata.com
- Billing: Amir Khan (amir.khan@nimbledata.com) is the billing contact; they indicated a PO will likely be used and will provide the PO number once procurement issues final pricing.
- SOC 2: we performed a SOC 2 Type II in 2024; I'll upload the report to the Drive folder (link below) after redaction. For your intake, consider self-attestation first — procurement will request the full report later in the process.

A few high-level redline priorities from NimbleData legal:
1) Limitations on liability — propose cap at 2x fees (we'll provide a redline).
2) Data residency — prefer EU data be restricted to EU regions if processing occurs there; otherwise ask for carve-outs.
3) Order Form: need an option to add transfer pricing schedule for seats over 1,000 monthly tokens (they use variable pricing).

I've attached our initial MSA mark (Nimble_MSA_v1_redline.docx) — we highlighted the indemnity and liability sections. We'll be available for a short sync today at 11:00 PT if that works.

Best,

Sasha Patel
Head of Legal | NimbleData Inc.
sasha@nimbledata.com
+1 617-555-0181

Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form intake: signer matrix & template alignment

Thanks Sasha — helpful context and appreciate the SOC 2 heads-up.

Quick summary & next steps:
- Karthik: proceed with redline against Redwood template; please prioritize (1) indemnity/liability, (2) data residency language, (3) exhibit mapping (Exhibit A pricing) — target 7/15 for draft comments.
- Kimberly: confirm whether procurement will accept the SOC 2 self-attestation for initial approval; if not, let's note external evidence request in the intake sheet.
- Sasha/Amir: once you have the PO cadence and final pricing tiers, share the PO/transfer schedule and we'll fold into Exhibit A.

I'll prepare a short intake memo to attach to the redline package (will include a signer matrix and quick risk bullets). If anything changes on timing, ping me — otherwise I will expect the redline draft by 7/15 EOD.

Marissa
